title: REDUCING MISINFORMATION IN QUERY AUTOCOMPLETIONS
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical evaluation of anchor-text-based autocompletion versus query-log-based methods using Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR). While it discusses 'morally unacceptable' query suggestions and offensive content (racism, sexism) as the primary motivation for the research, it does not evaluate or benchmark ethical, moral, or religious frameworks or reasoning.
